pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped patches with high edge angularity and frequent jagged invaginations. Dark contiguous regions on the mid-flank exhibit high spatial area and sharp pixel gradients at the margins, while patches toward the ventral region transition into smaller, more rounded, and less saturated geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A dense network of light-colored corridors forming a complex graph of interconnected nodes. Junction nodes frequently connect three or four pathways. The pixel thickness of these corridors varies, being thinnest where large flank patches nearly touch and widest at junction intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck and shoulder transition as a dense, short-cropped mane with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear feature is present on the lower mid-flank, appearing as a sharp indentation or healed scar line cutting through multiple patch boundaries.
